name: MonarchCelebration
title: Celebration
wrapsNative: VStack of Text with a MonarchIcon tile; confetti drawn by Canvas inside TimelineView(.animation(minimumInterval:paused:)) that pauses after one fall; presented inline or by the app in sheet(isPresented:) with presentationDetents
summary: A success moment for a real milestone: an icon in a tinted tile with confetti that falls once, a title, a message and the next actions.
whenToUse: At the end of a flow or onboarding step that reached a real milestone: an account or domain verified, a first project published, a workspace set up.
whenNotToUse: For routine confirmations (saved, sent), use a MonarchToast. For a success that needs no moment, use a MonarchBanner in the success tone. For an empty screen, use MonarchEmptyState with the success kind.
api: init(_ title: String, message: String? = nil, systemImage: String = "checkmark", tone: MonarchTone = .success, decoration: MonarchCelebrationDecoration = .confetti, announces: Bool = true, @ViewBuilder actions: () -> Actions)

init(_ title: String, message: String? = nil, systemImage: String = "checkmark", tone: MonarchTone = .success, decoration: MonarchCelebrationDecoration = .confetti, announces: Bool = true) where Actions == EmptyView

options.name: message
options.description: What it means or what to do next, in muted text.

options.name: systemImage
options.description: The SF Symbol in the tile. Decorative.

options.name: tone
options.description: The tile's colours: the tone's subtle fill and strong foreground.

options.name: decoration
options.description: Confetti that falls once behind the icon, or none.

options.name: announces
options.description: Announces the title and message when it appears. Turn it off when it is part of the screen from the start.

options.name: actions
options.description: The next steps, side by side when they fit and stacked when they do not.

states.name: appearing
states.description: The tile grows from 85% to full size and twelve pieces fall once over about 1.9 seconds, fading in and out.

states.name: settled
states.description: The confetti has faded and stopped drawing; only the tile and text remain.

states.name: reduce motion
states.description: The tile appears at full size and the pieces rest as a still scatter at 70% opacity above it.

appearance: Centred text: the title in the default text role, the message in the muted role. The tile uses the tone's subtle background role and strong foreground role. The pieces use the five data colour roles, which have light, dark and high-contrast values.
platformNotes: The web ships two components: CelebrationPanel (inline) and Celebration (a dialog with a Continue button). On iOS one view covers both: place it inline, or present it with sheet(isPresented:) and put the Continue button in its actions. The web tone `accent` is not offered because MonarchTone has no accent case yet; any MonarchTone works, success by default. The web media slot takes any image; here the tile shows an SF Symbol. The web heading level has no iOS equivalent beyond the header trait. Android uses the same name and options.
accessibility: The title has the header trait; the message is read after it.
With announces on, the title and message are announced when it appears.
The icon tile and the confetti are hidden from VoiceOver; everything is said in the text.
The confetti only moves and fades, never flashes, falls once, and is still under Reduce Motion; the tile's growth is skipped too.
edgeCases: Long titles and messages wrap and stay centred; the panel is at most 448 points wide.
The confetti is drawn with Canvas, which is not mirrored in right-to-left layouts; the scatter has no direction, so it looks the same.
Showing it again with a new identity (id(_:)) plays the confetti again.
